KaTeX self-hosted vendor copy
=============================

Version:   0.16.11
Source:    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/
Downloaded: 2026-07-10
License:   MIT (https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/blob/main/LICENSE)

Files
-----
katex.min.css   stylesheet (references fonts/KaTeX_*.{woff2,woff,ttf})
katex.min.js    UMD/global build — exposes window.katex when loaded via <script>
fonts/          60 font files (woff2 + woff + ttf for each family)

Usage in tools
--------------
Load as a plain global (NOT an ES module) from a tool page. Paths are relative
to the tool's own index.html, e.g. from tools/two-asset/index.html:

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../vendor/katex/katex.min.css">
  <script defer src="../../vendor/katex/katex.min.js"></script>

Then, after load, `window.katex.render(texString, element, {throwOnError:false})`
or `window.katex.renderToString(texString, {throwOnError:false})`.

Re-download
-----------
  KVER=0.16.11
  curl -f "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@${KVER}/dist/katex.min.css" -o katex.min.css
  curl -f "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@${KVER}/dist/katex.min.js"  -o katex.min.js
  # fonts: for each name referenced in katex.min.css, fetch dist/fonts/<name>
